readiness: Rejected for integration: v1 loses P16 interception; v2 restores it but loses ordinary fresh P4 tackle. Stop after two attempts. No helper/profile combination or promotion.

definitions.timing: Native event tick labels versus first-load/physics step-end boundaries differ by up to .05 s. Entry geometry uses before-World; achieved catch velocity uses after-World. Grip survival without break is observed/right-censored at last joint sample, not an infinite secure hold.
definitions.capability: Full native 22-body plays, original setup/scouts/fatigue/seed. One defender only. Arrival replaces exact acquired moving-window drive branch; ball contests and existing carry requests protected. Separate support sensitivities start at first post-throw boundary. No helper rule, law, grip or global movement edit. Timeout outcomes censored.
definitions.mechanical: Exactly same acquired joint, native World/private history and queued first-step strikes. One defender support profile changed; six saved-command steps. Later acquisitions/bond decisions/strikes omitted from all arms. All .30-s slices censored; no physics law or helper change.

fresh.selection: Uniform draws within completed and other native pass strata, before candidate outcomes; flags/unfinished retained. Supplement first two actual interceptions per roster as ball-contest guards, deduplicated and separately labelled. First positive loaded defender on actual catcher, else nearest at catch, else actual interceptor, else minimum defender-to-low-flight distance. Fixture selection uses baseline truth; the experimental controller uses consumed pictures only.

definitions.flags: Penalized inputs separated; no pool of flags with clean outcomes. Interceptions recognized by acquisition/identity, not the final whistle category.
definitions.scope: One baseline-selected actual defender per play. This is not an all-defenders production policy. Sparse changed requests can move later attempt timing and RNG consumption; contact execution is not matched after that divergence.
